item.description:

000

BULLETIN
Tropical Storm Isaias Advisory Number   4
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL       AL092026
1000 AM CDT Wed Oct 07 2026

...HURRICANE AND STORM SURGE WATCHES ISSUED FOR PORTIONS OF THE
NORTHERN GULF COAST FOR STRENGTHENING ISAIAS...

SUMMARY OF 1000 AM CDT...1500 UTC...INFORMATION
-----------------------------------------------
LOCATION...22.4N 93.6W
ABOUT 260 MI...420 KM WNW OF PROGRESO MEXICO
ABOUT 540 MI...870 KM SSW OF THE MOUTH OF THE MISSISSIPPI RIVER
MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS...45 MPH...75 KM/H
PRESENT MOVEMENT...ENE OR 70 DEGREES AT 8 MPH...13 KM/H
MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE...1000 MB...29.53 INCHES

WATCHES AND WARNINGS
--------------------
CHANGES WITH THIS ADVISORY:

A Storm Surge Watch has been issued from the Mouth of the
Mississippi River eastward to Yankeetown, Florida.

A Hurricane Watch has been issued for the northern Gulf Coast from
Bay St. Louis, Mississippi to Indian Pass, Florida.

A Tropical Storm Watch has been issued for the northern Gulf Coast
from the Jefferson/Plaquemines Parish line, Louisiana to west
of Bay St. Louis, and from east of Indian Pass to Aucilla River,
Florida.

SUMMARY OF WATCHES AND WARNINGS IN EFFECT:

A Storm Surge Watch is in effect for...
* Mouth of the Mississippi River to Yankeetown

A Hurricane Watch is in effect for...
* Bay St. Louis to Indian Pass

A Tropical Storm Watch is in effect for...
* Jefferson/Plaquemines Parish line to west of Bay St. Louis
* East of Indian Pass to Aucilla River

A Storm Surge Watch means there is a possibility of life-
threatening inundation, from rising water moving inland from the
coastline, in the indicated locations during the next 48 hours.

A Hurricane Watch means that hurricane conditions are possible
within the watch area.

A Tropical Storm Watch means that tropical storm conditions are
possible within the watch area, generally within 48 hours.

DISCUSSION AND OUTLOOK
----------------------
At 1000 AM CDT (1500 UTC), the center of Tropical Storm Isaias was
located by an Air Force Reserve Hurricane Hunter aircraft near
latitude 22.4 North, longitude 93.6 West. Isaias is moving toward
the east-northeast near 8 mph (13 km/h).

Maximum sustained winds have increased to near 45 mph (75 km/h)
with higher gusts. Rapid strengthening is forecast over the next day
or two, and Isaias is expected to become a hurricane by Thursday.

HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND
----------------------
STORM SURGE:  The combination of a dangerous storm surge and the
tide will cause normally dry areas near the coast to be flooded.

Ocean Springs, MS to Indian Pass, FL...5-7 ft
Mobile Bay...5-7 ft

NEXT ADVISORY
-------------
Next intermediate advisory at 100 PM CDT.
Next complete advisory at 400 PM CDT.

$$
Forecaster Blake

Tropical Storm Isaias Discussion Number   3
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL       AL092026
400 AM CDT Wed Oct 07 2026

Satellite imagery depicts a bursting pattern with the tropical
cyclone this morning, with cloud top temperatures below -85 C in the
deep convection close to the estimated center.

Key Messages:

1. There is an increasing risk of dangerous wind and storm surge
impacts along portions of the northern Gulf Coast.
